description:
The fleet through LangChain4j's extension points on Micronaut: the fleet's
    AgentCards as a ToolProvider applied to every AiService, discovery and
    data tools, a take lease renewed per model round-trip, chat memory in a
    replicated space, model access as a fleet service (interoperable with the
    Spring AI model service), real embeddings for semantic discovery, and
    fleet-wide token usage.
